entry.title: NYSE Arca Proposes Moving Franklin Responsibly Sourced Gold ETF to Generic Listing Standards
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; NYSE Arca, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend the Franklin Responsibly Sourced Gold ETF Federal Register · Nov 13, 2026 · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Rule 8.201–E (Generic), as amended, allows for up to 15% of a trust’s net asset value (NAV) to consist of digital commodities or securities that do not independently meet the core generic eligibility 」 NYSE Arca has filed a rule change to shift the Franklin Responsibly Sourced Gold ETF's listing basis from Rule 8.201–E (Non-Generic) to Rule 8.201–E (Generic). The amended generic rule, approved in July 2026, allows up to 15% of a trust's NAV to consist of digital commodities. The Exchange states the Shares will meet the amended generic rule's initial and continued listing requirements. The change took effect on filing, and comments are due by December 4, 2026. entry.title: SFC and HKMA hold industry seminar on tokenisation ecosystem opportunities
entry.summary: SFC and HKMA hosted industry seminar on opportunities in Hong Kong’s fast-evolving tokenisation ecosystem SFC · Nov 12, 2026 · Speech · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Discussion topics included tokenisation-enabled opportunities in secondary trading and corporate treasury management, and ecosystem development that accelerates broader adoption in tokenised money and」 The SFC and HKMA jointly hosted a seminar attended by more than 200 financial sector stakeholders to discuss the development of Hong Kong's tokenisation ecosystem. Topics included opportunities in secondary trading and corporate treasury management, and use cases for broader adoption of tokenised money and tokenised investment products. The seminar followed the launch of round-the-clock secondary trading of tokenised public funds on a licensed virtual asset trading platform and Ensemble TX's support for 24/7 interbank settlement of tokenised deposits.

entry.title: HKMA and SFC co-host seminar on tokenisation and collaboration under Project Ensemble
entry.summary: HKMA and SFC co-host seminar to advance tokenisation in Hong Kong and promote collaborative opportunities within Project Ensemble HKMA · Nov 12, 2026 · Speech · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Project Ensemble aims to expand the scale of transactions by introducing more impactful tokenisation use cases that deliver tangible benefits and support a sustainable tokenisation market.」 The HKMA and SFC co-hosted a seminar on 11 November on Project Ensemble and tokenised SFC-authorised investment products, attended by about 200 industry practitioners. Banks and industry pioneers shared practical tokenisation experience. The regulators said they will keep working to broaden commercial uses of tokenised deposits in settling various tokenised investment products.

entry.title: OFAC notice of sanctions designations added to the SDN List
entry.summary: Notice of OFAC Sanctions Action Federal Register · Nov 12, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Designated pursuant to Executive Order 13902 of January 10, 2020, 'Imposing Sanctions With Respect to Additional Sectors of Iran,' 85 FR 2003, 3 CFR, 2020 Comp., p. 299 (E.O. 13902), for operating in 」 The U.S. Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control published names of persons added to its Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List. They were designated under Executive Order 13902 for operating in the digital asset sector of Iran's economy. Their property subject to U.S. jurisdiction is blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from transacting with them. The notice appeared in the Federal Register on November 12, 2026. entry.title: FSA Publishes Minutes of First 2026 Meeting of Study Group on Digital and Decentralized Finance
entry.summary: 「デジタル・分散型金融への対応のあり方等に関する研究会」（令和８事務年度第１回）議事要旨について公表しました。 金融庁 · Nov 11, 2026 · Report · CryptoTopic evidence: 「「デジタル・分散型金融への対応のあり方等に関する研究会」（令和８事務年度第１回）議事要旨」 The Financial Services Agency published the minutes of the first meeting for fiscal 2026 of its study group on how to respond to digital and decentralized finance. The meeting was held on October 20, 2026, and heard presentations from Nomura Holdings and Securitize Japan. Discussion covered on-chain finance, stablecoins and tokenized deposits, security tokens, DEX and DeFi, and the book-entry transfer system.

entry.title: Warning: Transactions with Unregistered Operators Carry High Risk
entry.summary: 「無登録業者との取引は要注意！！～ 無登録業者との取引は高リスク ～」のページを更新しました。 金融庁 · Nov 10, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「日本の居住者を相手に、株取引やＦＸ取引、暗号資産取引などの金融商品取引業・暗号資産交換業を行う者は、日本の法令に基づき、登録を受ける必要があります。」 The Financial Services Agency of Japan warns that operators conducting financial instruments or crypto-asset exchange business with residents of Japan must be registered. Unregistered operators cannot be verified by authorities for investor-protection arrangements, and many complaints cite withdrawal refusals, excessive fees, and sudden loss of contact. The notice provides a list of registered operators, ways to check for warnings, and consultation and information contacts. entry.title: FSRA statement on the Binance security incident
entry.summary: FSRA Statement Regarding Security Incident Involving Binance 30 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 30, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The FSRA is aware of the matter relating to Binance exchange on 30 October 2026, concerning a security incident involving unauthorised withdrawals of assets.」 The Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM says it is aware of a security incident at the Binance exchange on 30 October 2026 involving unauthorised withdrawals of assets. The FSRA is working closely with Binance and monitoring the situation. Protecting client interests and supporting market integrity and orderly functioning are its key priorities.

entry.title: Withdrawal of Proposal to Lower Cross-Border Funds Transfer Information Threshold and Clarify Crypto Application
entry.summary: Threshold for the Requirement To Collect, Retain, and Transmit Information on Funds Transfers and Transmittals of Funds That Begin or End Outside the United States, and Clarification of the Requirement To Collect, Retain, and Transmit Information on Transactions Involving Convertible Virtual Currencies and Digital Assets With Legal Tender Status; Withdrawal Federal Register · Nov 9, 2026 · Draft / consultation · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Clarification of the Requirement To Collect, Retain, and Transmit Information on Transactions Involving Convertible Virtual Currencies and Digital Assets With Legal Tender Status」 FinCEN and the Federal Reserve Board are withdrawing a 2020 joint proposal that would have lowered the threshold for collecting and transmitting information on cross-border funds transfers from $3,000 to $250 and clarified that the rules apply to transactions involving convertible virtual currency and digital assets with legal tender status. The agencies cite the passage of more than five years since the proposal and significant recent developments in the crypto industry. Any future amendments would be considered in light of these changes and subject to further public comment. entry.title: Arab Bank Switzerland opens Abu Dhabi office and names Valérie Noël CEO
entry.summary: Arab Bank Switzerland opens Abu Dhabi office and names Valérie Noël Chief Executive Officer 05 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 5, 2026 · Licensing · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Arab Bank Switzerland ME Ltd, the regional entity of Swiss Private Bank Arab Bank Switzerland, has announced the start of its operations in ADGM, the international financial centre of Abu Dhabi, follo」 Arab Bank Switzerland ME Ltd, the regional entity of Swiss private bank Arab Bank Switzerland, has started operations in ADGM after receiving a Financial Services Permission from the FSRA. The entity will advise institutions, corporates, fintechs, family offices and high net worth clients on accessing, holding, managing and passing on digital assets within ADGM's regulatory framework. Valérie Noël has been appointed Chief Executive Officer.

entry.title: The Not-So-Fine Print: How the FCA Makes Consumer Contracts Fair
entry.summary: The not-so-fine print: making consumer contracts fair FCA · Nov 6, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「A crypto firm agreed to stop charging excessive storage fees which, in some cases, could exceed £40,000 a year.」 The UK Financial Conduct Authority explains how it checks whether terms in financial consumer contracts are fair and transparent under the Consumer Rights Act 2015. It gives examples including a crypto firm that stopped excessive storage fees, an adviser that dropped a complaint-handling charge, and a travel insurer that clarified unclear delay terms. It sets out what firms should do, such as using plain language and reviewing contracts regularly.

entry.title: Consultation conclusions on tightening limits on misleading names used by unregulated entities
entry.summary: SFC concludes consultation on further restricting use of misleading names by unregulated entities to protect investors SFC · Nov 6, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「a similar provision under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (AMLO)」 The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) of Hong Kong published the conclusions of its consultation on restricting unregulated entities from adopting names that may falsely suggest regulated status. Respondents broadly supported expanding the restricted titles list under the Securities and Futures Ordinance and adding a similar provision to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance. The SFC agreed to a faster list-update mechanism and plans to introduce an amendment bill to the Legislative Council.

entry.title: ADGM publishes guidance on crypto mining as the region's first such guidance
entry.summary: ADGM Becomes the Region's First International Financial Centre to Publish Dedicated Crypto Mining Guidance 28 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 28, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「the Guidance treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA and not a regulated financial service」 The Registration Authority of Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) has published its Guidance on Crypto Mining Activities in and from ADGM. Issued under section 23 of the Commercial Licensing Regulations 2025, it treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA rather than a regulated financial service. The guidance applies a technology-neutral approach covering Proof-of-Work, Proof-of-Stake and future consensus mechanisms.

entry.title: Animoca Brands gets ADGM regulator permission to manage collective investment funds
entry.summary: Animoca Brands secures Financial Services Permission from ADGM’s FSRA to Manage Collective Investment funds 02 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 2, 2026 · Licensing · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Animoca Brands today announced that its subsidiary, Animoca Asset Management (AD) Limited (AAM), has received a Financial Services Permission (FSP) by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA」 Animoca Brands announced that its subsidiary, Animoca Asset Management (AD) Limited (AAM), received a Financial Services Permission from the FSRA of ADGM. The permission authorizes it to manage collective investment funds in or from ADGM. The company says the permission extends its institutional capabilities and supports its expansion in the Middle East.

entry.title: Texas Stock Exchange rule change on commodity-based trust shares, with accelerated approval
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Texas Stock Exchange LLC; Notice of Filing, and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of, a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Rule 17.111(d) (Commodity-Based Trust Shares) Federal Register · Nov 3, 2026 · Licensing · CryptoTopic evidence: 「permit up to 15% of the net asset value of the Trust’s holdings to consist of certain digital commodities and securities that do not otherwise satisfy the applicable eligibility criteria」 The SEC published notice of, and approved on an accelerated basis, a Texas Stock Exchange proposal to amend Rule 17.111(d) and adopt generic listing standards for Commodity-Based Trust Shares. Under the change, such shares can be listed under Rule 19b-4(e) without a separate filing for each product. The proposal permits up to 15% of a trust's net asset value to consist of certain digital commodities and allows actively managed shares, and the Commission waived the 30-day operative delay. entry.title: HKMA extends Project Ensemble pilot to 24/7 interbank settlement of tokenised deposits
entry.summary: HKMA advances Project Ensemble pilot phase to 24/7 settlement in tokenised Central Bank Money HKMA · Nov 2, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「support the interbank settlement of tokenised deposit transactions in tokenised Central Bank Money (CeBM) on a 24/7 basis」 The HKMA announced that EnsembleTX, the pilot phase of Project Ensemble, now supports 24/7 interbank settlement of tokenised deposit transactions in tokenised Central Bank Money. Participating banks rose to 12 and industry pioneers to 20. The capability lets participants settle tokenised transactions beyond conventional operating hours.

entry.title: Speech by SFC Executive Director Elisa Ng: scaling tokenisation in Hong Kong's capital markets
entry.summary: New speech by Elisa Ng: Keynote at Hong Kong FinTech Week x StartmeupHK 2026 SFC · Nov 2, 2026 · Speech · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Tokenisation involves the use of blockchain-based tokens to represent ownership of assets.」 Elisa Ng, the SFC's Executive Director of Investment Products, gave a keynote at Hong Kong FinTech Week on 2 November 2026. She highlighted secondary trading of tokenised money market funds and treasury management linking tokenised funds with digital money.
